tools.name: market_data_get_price_history
tools.title: Market Data Get Price History
tools.description: Fetch OHLCV price history for `ticker`, smart-cached via the service.

tools.name: market_data_get_price_history_batch
tools.title: Market Data Get Price History Batch
tools.description:
Fetch OHLCV price history for multiple tickers.

A single bad ticker's failure is captured per-ticker in `results` rather
than aborting the whole batch; a shared bad `start_date`/`end_date`
(parsed once up front), or a `tickers` list exceeding `settings.
history_batch_max`, fails the whole call instead, since neither can be
attributed to any one ticker. The happy path (including one with
per-ticker failures) always carries a top-level `"status": "success"` so
callers can branch on it uniformly before looking at `results`.

tools.name: market_data_get_quote
tools.title: Market Data Get Quote
tools.description: Fetch a single quote (TTL-cached by the service).

tools.name: market_data_get_stock_fundamentals
tools.title: Market Data Get Stock Fundamentals
tools.description: Fetch company fundamentals: valuation, financials, and trading stats.

tools.name: market_data_get_market_overview
tools.title: Market Data Get Market Overview
tools.description: Fetch indices, sector performance, top movers, and volatility.

tools.name: market_data_get_chart_links
tools.title: Market Data Get Chart Links
tools.description: Static external chart links for `ticker` (no service call, no network).

tools.name: market_data_clear_market_cache
tools.title: Market Data Clear Market Cache
tools.description:
Clear the cached quote for `ticker`, or every quote plus the market
overview cache when `ticker` is omitted.

tools.name: screening_get_bullish
tools.title: Screening Get Bullish
tools.description: Top bullish-momentum screen results, newest snapshot only.

tools.name: screening_get_bearish
tools.title: Screening Get Bearish
tools.description: Top bearish screen results, newest snapshot only.

tools.name: screening_get_supply_demand
tools.title: Screening Get Supply Demand
tools.description: Top supply/demand breakout screen results, newest snapshot only.

tools.name: screening_get_all
tools.title: Screening Get All
tools.description: Latest snapshot across all three screens (each independently dated).

tools.name: screening_get_by_criteria
tools.title: Screening Get By Criteria
tools.description: Latest bullish screen results filtered by arbitrary criteria (AND-ed).

tools.name: screening_run_screens
tools.title: Screening Run Screens
tools.description:
Recompute one screen (or all three when `screen` is omitted) and persist it.

Always returns a `screen name -> ScreenRun` mapping under `results`, even
for a single explicit screen, so callers never need to branch on shape.
Screens only symbols already known locally; with none, returns an error
that says how to add them.

tools.name: portfolio_get_my_portfolio
tools.title: Portfolio Get My Portfolio
tools.description: Full portfolio snapshot: every position plus live-priced metrics.

tools.name: portfolio_risk_adjusted_analysis
tools.title: Portfolio Risk Adjusted Analysis
tools.description:
ATR-based position sizing/stop/target for `ticker`, plus an
existing-position block if `portfolio_name` already holds it.

tools.name: portfolio_compare_tickers
tools.title: Portfolio Compare Tickers
tools.description:
Side-by-side comparison of `tickers`, or of `portfolio_name`'s
holdings when `tickers` is omitted (requires >= 2 holdings).

tools.name: portfolio_correlation_analysis
tools.title: Portfolio Correlation Analysis
tools.description:
Correlation matrix and diversification metrics for `tickers`, or for
`portfolio_name`'s holdings when `tickers` is omitted (requires >= 2
holdings).

tools.name: portfolio_get_risk_dashboard
tools.title: Portfolio Get Risk Dashboard
tools.description:
Full risk dashboard for `portfolio_name`: total value, sector
concentration, parametric VaR (95/99), and total unrealized P&L.

tools.name: portfolio_check_position_risk
tools.title: Portfolio Check Position Risk
tools.description:
Pre-trade risk check: current vs. projected portfolio risk if
`shares` of `ticker` were added at `entry_price`.

tools.name: portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing
tools.title: Portfolio Get Regime Adjusted Sizing
tools.description:
Position size scaled by the current SPY-detected market regime
(bull = full risk, choppy/transitional = 75%, bear = 50%).

tools.name: portfolio_get_risk_alerts
tools.title: Portfolio Get Risk Alerts
tools.description:
Current risk alerts for `portfolio_name`: sector concentration,
oversized positions, and portfolio drawdown threshold breaches.

tools.name: portfolio_watchlist_brief
tools.title: Portfolio Watchlist Brief
tools.description:
Intelligence brief for every symbol on a watchlist: notes, days on
watchlist, and the current price via market_data.

tools.name: portfolio_watchlist_list
tools.title: Portfolio Watchlist List
tools.description: List saved watchlist IDs, names, and descriptions in creation order.

tools.name: portfolio_journal_list_trades
tools.title: Portfolio Journal List Trades
tools.description:
List journal trades, optionally filtered by symbol, status
(open/closed), or strategy tag. Newest entry date first.

tools.name: portfolio_journal_review
tools.title: Portfolio Journal Review
tools.description:
Full detail for a single trade by ID, including the side-aware
`pnl_pct` (only populated once the trade is closed).

tools.name: portfolio_get_strategy_performance
tools.title: Portfolio Get Strategy Performance
tools.description:
Strategy performance analytics. `compare=False` (default) returns
win/loss/expectancy/profit-factor for a single `strategy_tag`
(required). `compare=True` returns every strategy ranked by expectancy
descending, absorbing legacy's separate `get_strategy_comparison` tool
into this one via the flag -- `strategy_tag` is ignored in that mode.

tools.name: portfolio_add_position
tools.title: Portfolio Add Position
tools.description: Add (or average into) a position in `portfolio_name`.

tools.name: portfolio_remove_position
tools.title: Portfolio Remove Position
tools.description: Remove `shares` from `ticker` (or the entire position when omitted).

tools.name: portfolio_clear_portfolio
tools.title: Portfolio Clear Portfolio
tools.description: Remove every position from `portfolio_name`. Requires `confirm=True`.

tools.name: portfolio_watchlist_create
tools.title: Portfolio Watchlist Create
tools.description:
Create a new named watchlist for tracking ticker symbols. The name
must be unique.

tools.name: portfolio_watchlist_add
tools.title: Portfolio Watchlist Add
tools.description:
Add a ticker symbol to an existing watchlist. Repeat calls for the
same symbol add another entry rather than replacing it.

tools.name: portfolio_watchlist_remove
tools.title: Portfolio Watchlist Remove
tools.description: Remove a ticker symbol from a watchlist.

tools.name: portfolio_journal_add_trade
tools.title: Portfolio Journal Add Trade
tools.description:
Add an open trade to the journal. `entry_date` is an ISO 8601 date or
datetime (for example `2026-03-15` or `2026-03-15T14:30:00Z`) for a trade
made earlier; omit it to record the trade as entered now. Naive dates
are UTC. Side is long or short (case-insensitive); prices and shares
must be finite and positive. Unit prices retain subcent precision.

tools.name: portfolio_journal_close_trade
tools.title: Portfolio Journal Close Trade
tools.description:
Close an open trade by entry ID. PnL is computed automatically
(long: exit-entry, short: entry-exit), multiplied by shares, then
rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP. Exit price must be finite and
positive. Strategy performance is recomputed for every trade tag.

tools.name: technical_get_rsi_analysis
tools.title: Technical Get Rsi Analysis
tools.description:
RSI reading and signal label for `ticker`.

`period`/`days` left `None` fall back to `TechnicalSettings` defaults.

tools.name: technical_get_macd_analysis
tools.title: Technical Get Macd Analysis
tools.description:
MACD reading, signal label, and crossover state for `ticker`.

Any period left `None` falls back to its `TechnicalSettings` default.

tools.name: technical_get_support_resistance
tools.title: Technical Get Support Resistance
tools.description:
Observed low/high range for `ticker`, a support/resistance heuristic.

`days` selects calendar history; `None` uses `sr_lookback` bars (default 30).
Returns the method and number of bars used, without synthetic price levels.

tools.name: technical_get_full_technical_analysis
tools.title: Technical Get Full Technical Analysis
tools.description:
Full technical analysis for `ticker`: trend, outlook, and every indicator.

Levels use the requested calendar `days`, or 30 trailing bars by default.
Indicators fetch additional history for warm-up.

tools.name: backtesting_run_backtest
tools.title: Backtesting Run Backtest
tools.description: Run a single-strategy backtest and return metrics, trades, and analysis.

tools.name: backtesting_optimize_strategy
tools.title: Backtesting Optimize Strategy
tools.description: Grid-search a strategy's parameters (sma_cross, rsi, macd, bollinger, or momentum only).

tools.name: backtesting_walk_forward_analysis
tools.title: Backtesting Walk Forward Analysis
tools.description: Roll a strategy forward through repeated optimize/test windows to gauge robustness.

tools.name: backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation
tools.title: Backtesting Monte Carlo Simulation
tools.description: Bootstrap-resample a backtest's trades to estimate a return/drawdown distribution.

tools.name: backtesting_compare_strategies
tools.title: Backtesting Compare Strategies
tools.description: Backtest multiple strategies on the same symbol and rank them.

tools.name: backtesting_list_strategies
tools.title: Backtesting List Strategies
tools.description: List every available rule-based strategy template with its default parameters.

tools.name: backtesting_backtest_portfolio
tools.title: Backtesting Backtest Portfolio
tools.description:
Backtest one strategy across multiple symbols and aggregate portfolio-level
metrics.

Each symbol is backtested independently (no combined equity curve, no
cross-symbol correlation). `total_return`/`average_sharpe` are per-symbol
averages; `max_drawdown` is the worst (most negative) constituent
drawdown, not a joint-portfolio calculation.

tools.name: backtesting_run_ml_strategy_backtest
tools.title: Backtesting Run Ml Strategy Backtest
tools.description:
Run a backtest using an ML-enhanced strategy (ml_predictor, adaptive, ensemble, or
regime_aware).

tools.name: backtesting_train_ml_predictor
tools.title: Backtesting Train Ml Predictor
tools.description: Train a random-forest ML predictor model for trading signals.

tools.name: backtesting_analyze_market_regimes
tools.title: Backtesting Analyze Market Regimes
tools.description:
Analyze market regimes (bear/sideways/bull) for a symbol using ML methods.

`method="hmm"` (the default) fits an `sklearn.mixture.GaussianMixture`,
not a genuine Hidden Markov Model -- the name is kept for backward
compatibility. `method="kmeans"` is real k-means clustering;
`method="threshold"` is a zero-model rule-based classifier. The returned
`method` field reports what was actually used, which can differ from the
request if there wasn't enough history to fit a statistical model
(silently falls back to "threshold"). Each history entry's
`probabilities` are the fitted model's real posterior when one exists,
otherwise an honest one-hot at the assigned regime -- never a fabricated
uniform distribution.

tools.name: backtesting_create_strategy_ensemble
tools.title: Backtesting Create Strategy Ensemble
tools.description: Create and backtest a weighted ensemble of base strategies across multiple symbols.

tools.name: backtesting_parse_strategy
tools.title: Backtesting Parse Strategy
tools.description:
Parse a natural-language strategy description into a strategy type and parameters,
using the configured BYOK LLM when available and degrading to zero-dependency keyword
parsing otherwise (see `strategies.parser.StrategyParser.parse_with_llm`).

tools.name: research_run_comprehensive
tools.title: Research Run Comprehensive
tools.description: Run comprehensive web-search-backed research on a financial topic.

tools.name: research_analyze_company
tools.title: Research Analyze Company
tools.description: Run comprehensive research on a specific company.

tools.name: research_analyze_sentiment
tools.title: Research Analyze Sentiment
tools.description: Analyze market sentiment for a specific topic or sector.

result.description: Full technical + screening workflow for one ticker.

content.text:
Analyze AAPL using this workflow:

1. `market_data_get_quote('AAPL')` and
   `market_data_get_stock_fundamentals('AAPL')` for the current price,
   valuation, and company snapshot.
2. `technical_get_full_technical_analysis('AAPL')` for trend, RSI,
   MACD, stochastic, Bollinger Bands, volume, and support/resistance
   levels in one call.
3. `screening_get_by_criteria(...)` (or `screening_get_bullish`/
   `screening_get_bearish`) to see whether AAPL already qualifies for
   one of the standing screens, for cross-confirmation with step 2's
   outlook.
4. Optionally, `market_data_get_price_history('AAPL')` for the raw
   OHLCV series backing the analysis, and `market_data_get_chart_links(
   'AAPL')` for external chart references.

Summarize: current price and valuation, technical outlook (trend +
momentum + volatility), whether AAPL appears on any screen, and a
plain-language read of the setup. This is educational analysis, not
financial advice.

content.text:
Review the 'My Portfolio' portfolio using this workflow:

1. `portfolio_get_my_portfolio(portfolio_name='My Portfolio')` for
   every position with live prices and unrealized P&L.
2. `portfolio_get_risk_dashboard(portfolio_name='My Portfolio')` for
   total exposure, sector concentration, and parametric VaR (95/99).
3. `portfolio_get_risk_alerts(portfolio_name='My Portfolio')` for any
   sector-concentration, oversized-position, or drawdown threshold
   breaches that need attention now.
4. `portfolio_correlation_analysis(portfolio_name='My Portfolio')` to
   check how diversified the holdings actually are.
5. Before adding a new position, run `portfolio_check_position_risk(...)`
   to see how it would change the portfolio's risk profile pre-trade, and
   `portfolio_get_regime_adjusted_sizing(...)` for a position size scaled
   to the current market regime.

Summarize: total value and P&L, concentration/diversification concerns,
any active risk alerts, and one or two concrete suggestions. This is
educational analysis, not financial advice.

result.description: Strategy backtesting workflow (registered only with the `[backtesting]` extra).

content.text:
Backtest a strategy on AAPL using this workflow:

1. `backtesting_list_strategies()` to see every available rule-based
   strategy template and its default parameters (use
   `backtesting_parse_strategy(...)` first if you only have a
   natural-language description of a strategy).
2. `backtesting_run_backtest(symbol='AAPL', strategy='sma_cross')`
   for metrics, trades, and analysis on the default date range.
3. `backtesting_optimize_strategy(symbol='AAPL', strategy='sma_cross')`
   to grid-search that strategy's parameters for a better result.
4. `backtesting_monte_carlo_simulation(symbol='AAPL',
   strategy='sma_cross')` to see a bootstrap-resampled distribution of
   likely outcomes, not just the single historical path.
5. `backtesting_compare_strategies(symbol='AAPL')` to rank several
   strategies against each other on the same symbol, and
   `backtesting_walk_forward_analysis(...)` to check the winner's
   robustness across rolling out-of-sample windows.

Summarize: headline metrics (return, Sharpe, max drawdown, win rate),
whether optimization meaningfully improved on the defaults, and the
Monte Carlo outcome spread. This is educational backtesting on historical
data, not a guarantee of future performance or financial advice.
